name: study-time-tracker
description: A simple dark-mode Windows study time tracker
author: Ashish Bharadwaj

scripts.dist: electron-builder --win nsis --config builder-config.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const src='C:/Users/ashis/AppData/Local/Temp/study-tracker-dist/Study Time Tracker Setup 1.0.0.exe';if(fs.existsSync(src))fs.copyFileSync(src, 'dist/Study Time Tracker Setup 1.0.0.exe')"
scripts.dist:portable: electron-builder --win portable --config builder-config.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const src='C:/Users/ashis/AppData/Local/Temp/study-tracker-dist/Study Time Tracker Portable 1.0.0.exe';if(fs.existsSync(src))fs.copyFileSync(src, 'dist/Study Time Tracker Portable 1.0.0.exe')"
